name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-bubble-sort
code:
use default

bubble_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let sorted mut = false

    while !sorted do
        sorted = true

        for i in 0..values.count - 1 do
            if values[i] > values[i + 1] then
                (values[i], values[i + 1]) = (values[i + 1], values[i])

                sorted = false
            fi
        od
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

bubble_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

bubble_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
